v: na॰ anja--DAtvarTanirdeSe Rvul kutsitA aYjikA vyaktiryasya । AranAle (kA~ji) hemaca॰ । tasya graRAdi sAva॰ pra॰ uktaM yaTA “kAYjikaM rocanaM rucyaM pAcanaM vahnidIpanam । SUlAjIrRRavibanDaGnaM kozWaSudDikaraM param” anyatra vEdyake ca “saMhitaM DAnyamaRqAdi kAYjikaM kaTyate janEH । kAYjikamBedi tIkzRozRaM rocanaM pAcanaM laGu । dAhajvaraharaM sparSAt pAnAdvAtakaPApaham । nAzAdivawakEryattu kriyate tadguRADikam । laGu vAtaharaM tattu rocanaM pAcanamparam । SUlAjorRavibanDAnAM nASanaM vastiSoDanam । DAnyAmlamacCataramAmanivAri hAri SuRWIrajolavaRajIrakasaMskftaM yat । AvAsitaM suraBi hiNgukaRena yatnAt tenASuSukzaRikaRo'DikatAM prayAti । elAmahOzaDaviBAvitamARimanTaM saMsidDamAmalakamedakakAYjikaM yat । mandaM vivardDayati jAWaravItihotraM nirvARadIpamiva ganDakacUrRRayogaH । kAYjikaM rucidaM hfdyaM svacCamagnikaraM param । vAtahfdbaladaM SrezWaM gurvAhArasya pAcakam” । anyatra ca “kAYjikaM daDitElantu balIpalitanASanam । gAtraSETilyadAnAya marddanAnna ca BakzaRAt” । BAvapra॰ tadBedatadviDAnAdyuktaM yaTA--“kulmAzaDAnyamaRqena saMhitaM kAYjikaM Bavet । yanmastvAdi SucO BARqe saguqaM kzOdrakAYjikam । DAnyarASO trirAtrasTaM SuktaM cukraM taducyate । tuzAmbusaMhitam jYeyamAmErvidalitEryavEH । yavestu nistuzEH pakvEH sOvIraM sADitaM Bavet । AranAlantu goDUmErAmEH syAnnistuzIkftEH । pakvErvA saMhitE stattu sOvIrasadfSaM guREH । kalmAzaDAnyamaRqAdi saMhitaM kAYjikaM viduH । SiRqikA saMhitA jYeyA mUlakEH sarzapAdiBiH” ।
m: काञ्जिक n. sour gruel, water of boiled rice in a state of spontaneous fermentation, Suśr.
काञ्जिक—पूजा f. N. of a Jaina work.

s: kAYjikavawakaH

puM, (kAYjikayogena kfto vawakaH .) vawakaviSezaH । kA~ji vaqA iti BAzA । tasya pAkaprakAro yaTA, -- “manTanI nUtanA DAryyA kawutElena lepitA । nirmmalenAmbunApUryya tasyAYcUrRaM vinikzipet ॥ rAjikAjIralavaRahiNguSuRWIniSAkftam । nikzipedvawakAMstatra BARqasyAsyaYca mudrayet ॥ tato dinatrayAdUrdDvamamlAH syurvawakA Druvam” ॥ asya guRAH । “kAYjikavawako rucyo vAtaharaH SlezmakArakaH SItaH । dAhaM SUlamajIrRaM harate netrAmayezvahitaH” ॥ iti BAvaprakASaH ॥
v: pu॰ (kA~jivaqA) prasidDe BAvaprakASokte vawakaBede tadviDAnaguRAdi tatroktaM yaTA “manTanI nUtanA DAryyA kawutElena lepitA । nirmmalenAmbunApUryya tasyAM cUrRRaM viniHkzipet । rAjikAjIralavaRahiNguSuRWIniSAkftAn । niHkzipedvawakAMstatra BARqasyAsyaYca mudrayet । tatodinatrayAdUrdDamamlAH syurvawakA Druvam । kAYjiko vawakorucyo vAtaGnaH SlezmakArakaH” । SItodAhaM SUlamajIrRRaM harate dfgAmayezvahitaH” ।
m: काञ्जिक—वटक m. a dish consisting of sour gruel, meal, and several condiments, Bhpr.
